versions.changelog:
Initial release of roundtable-forge — a router skill for managing structured, multi-agent, cross-disciplinary roundtable discussions.

- Routes user questions into roundtable discussions featuring real, historical, or fictional characters as independent agents.
- Supports various discussion structures (standard, six hats, delphi, world cafe, fishbone) and output formats (minutes, podcast, argument graph).
- Includes dynamic agent selection and coordination via a Conductor, with real-time shared Memory and a persistent argument graph.
- Integrates with subagent runtime tools when supported for true multi-agent execution.
- Designed for natural, in-depth exploration with traceable argumentation and flexible workflows.
